guesses.question: You said Glass Harbour made you slow down on your walk home, and that Second Lamp kept you company until the ovens were done. Did both records come to you in that same winter of 2021?

quotes.quote: Glass Harbour came into my life in the winter of 2021
during a night shift that same winter

what_it_did.quote: It made me slow down on that walk instead of rushing to bed.
That song kept me company until the ovens were done.
